cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You said you'd announce the budget cut if your plan cost more. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then the announcement can be slightly apologetic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. But the bargain gave you this development opportunity.

mechanism: A keeps B responsible for announcing the overrun while offering wording and rehearsal help instead of taking over the consequence.
confusable: Unlike merely criticising overspending, A obtains the promised unpleasant public next step.
comparison: A shared draft and rehearsal retain B announcement duty, unlike the washing-up penalty.
seedUse: D197-b budget overrun and better explanation; S02-b provides expertise while B remains the speaker.
